Name: Farm Cave Underground Quarry
Author: M0onshineFox
Description:
Grandpa's farm may not have a large amount of space, but he still made good money through a small cavern under the farm filled with ore and quarry stone!

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

I've been partial to smaller maps for a while, but there's not really any small versions of the mountain farm, so I decided to add my own quarry under the ground!

The mod adds the stairs to access the new area into the farm cave. It works with the base farm cave, and the Hidden Spring Farm Cave.

Incompatible with the immersive farm 2 cave, and possibly others.

Manifest.Name: Moonshine_Farm_Quarry
Manifest.Description: Adds a small underground quarry to the farm cave.
